input_contract: Earlier structured ESCO-coded employment history plus education; not raw CV text.
output_contract: Up to three exploratory role suggestions with explicit user confirmation.
reason_high_confidence_disabled: The validation set is too small and the model is not calibrated for the product's >=70% high-confidence badge.
no_match_policy: Return no match when model evidence is insufficient; never select a random role.
retraining_gate: Collect consented, labeled Malaysian resume text and validate class support, calibration, and subgroup performance before production use.
